reuse.why: Fintegra linking goes through a shared linkExternalAccount/linkSyncServerAccount (with assertBankAccountNotLinked, findOrCreateBank, syncAccount, handleSyncResponse) and downloads through a shared downloadSimpleProviderTransactions used by Pluggy.ai and Akahu too.

duplication.why: Collapses five near-identical link functions and two identical download functions into shared helpers instead of adding a sixth/third copy; only the akahu||fintegra balance branch is a small repetition point.

placement.why: Linking stays in server/accounts/app.ts, download/sync dispatch in sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts and the type in types/models, mirroring the other providers.

scope.why: A server-only feature request becomes a broad refactor of every existing provider's link and download path (plus small client edits), which enlarges review and regression risk beyond the asked change.

maintainability.why: The extracted helpers make the next provider trivial and keep provider quirks explicit (bankKey, fileId, syncedTables), though the unrequested refactor of GoCardless/EnableBanking deserves its own change.
